G4701.def: from «4687»; a sowing, i.e. (by implication) parentage:--seed.

G4702.def: from «4703»; sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field:--corn(-field).

G4703.def: from «4687»; a scattering (of seed), i.e. (concretely) seed (as sown):--seed (X sown).

G4704.def: from «4710»; to use speed, i.e. to make effort, be prompt or earnest:--do (give) diligence, be diligent (forward), endeavour, labour, study.

G4706.def: neuter of «4707» as adverb; more earnestly than others), i.e. very promptly:--very diligently.

G4707.def: comparative of «4705»; more prompt, more earnest:--more diligent (forward).

G4708.def: adverb from «4707»; more speedily, i.e. sooner than otherwise:--more carefully.

G4710.def: from «4692»; "speed", i.e. (by implication) despatch, eagerness, earnestness:--business, (earnest) care(-fulness), diligence, forwardness, haste.

G4711.def: from «4687» (as woven); a hamper or lunch-receptacle:--basket.

G4712.et: or masculine (in plural) stadios {stad'-ee-os}, from the base of (2476) (as fixed)
G4712.def: from the base of «2476» (as fixed); a stade or certain measure of distance; by implication, a stadium or race-course:--furlong, race.

G4713.def: from the base of «2476» (as stationary); a jar or earthen tank:--pot.

G4714.def: from the base of «2476»; a standing (properly, the act), i.e. (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy:--dissension, insurrection, × standing, uproar.

G4715.def: from the base of «2746»; a stander (standard of value), i.e. (specially), a stater or certain coin:--piece of money.

G4716.def: from the base of «2476»; a stake or post (as set upright), i.e. (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e. self-denial; by implication, the atonement of Christ:--cross.

G4717.def: from «4716»; to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness:--crucify.

G4718.def: probably from the base of «4735»; a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined):--grapes.

G4719.def: from the base of «2476»; a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk):--ear (of corn).

G4720.def: the same as «4719»; Stachys, a Christian:--Stachys.

G4721.et: strengthened from a primary tegos (a "thatch" or "deck" of a building)
G4721.def: strengthened from a primary tegos (a "thatch" or "deck" of a building); a roof:--roof.

G4722.def: from «4721»; to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently):--(for-)bear, suffer.

G4723.et: a contraction from (4731) (as stiff and unnatural)
G4723.def: a contraction from «4731» (as stiff and unnatural); "sterile":--barren.

G4724.et: probably strengthened from the base of (2476)
G4724.def: probably strengthened from the base of «2476»; properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e. (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with):--avoid, withdraw self.

G4725.def: from the base of «4735»; a wreath for show:--garland.

G4727.def: from «4728»; to make (intransitively, be) in straits, i.e. (by implication) to sigh, murmur, pray inaudibly:--with grief, groan, grudge, sigh.

G4728.def: probably from the base of «2476»; narrow (from obstacles standing close about):--strait.

G4729.def: from the same as «4730»; to hem in closely, i.e. (figuratively) cramp:--distress, straiten.

G4730.def: from a compound of «4728» and «5561»; narrowness of room, i.e. (figuratively) calamity:--anguish, distress.

G4731.def: from «2476»; stiff, i.e. solid, stable (literally or figuratively):--stedfast, strong, sure.

G4732.def: from «4731»; to solidify, i.e. confirm (literally or figuratively):--establish, receive strength, make strong.

G4734.def: probably contraction for stephanotos (crowned; from «4737»); Stephanas, a Christian:--Stephanas.

G4735.et: from an apparently primary stepho (to twine or wreathe)
G4735.def: from an apparently primary stepho (to twine or wreathe); a chaplet (as a badge of royalty, a prize in the public games or a symbol of honor generally; but more conspicuous and elaborate than the simple fillet, «1238»), literally or figuratively:--crown.

G4736.def: the same as «4735»; Stephanus, a Christian:--Stephen.

G4737.def: from «4735»; to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively):--crown.

G4738.def: from «2476» (as standing prominently); the (entire external) bosom, i.e. chest:--breast.

G4739.def: from the perfect tense of «2476»; to be stationary, i.e. (figuratively) to persevere:--stand (fast).

G4741.def: from a presumed derivative of «2476» (like «4731»); to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm:--fix, (e-)stablish, stedfastly set, strengthen.

G4742.et: from a primary stizo (to "stick", i.e. prick)
G4742.def: from a primary stizo (to "stick", i.e. prick); a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e. (figuratively) scar of service:--mark.

G4743.def: feminine of «4742»; a point of time, i.e. an instant:--moment.

G4744.def: apparently a primary verb; to gleam, i.e. flash intensely:--shining.

G4745.def: probably from «2476»; a colonnade or interior piazza:--porch.

G4746.def: from a primary steibo (to "step" or "stamp"); a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e. (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed:--branch.

G4747.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (4748)
G4747.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of «4748»; something orderly in arrangement, i.e. (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively):--element, principle, rudiment.

G4748.et: from a derivative of steicho (to range in regular line)
G4748.def: from a derivative of steicho (to range in regular line); to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e. (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety:--walk (orderly).

G4749.def: from «4724»; equipment, i.e. (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity):--long clothing (garment), (long) robe.

G4750.et: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of (5114)
G4750.def: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of «5114»; the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon):--edge, face, mouth.

G4751.def: from «4750»; an orifice (the gullet), i.e. (specially), the "stomach":--stomach.

G4752.def: from «4754»; military service, i.e. (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger):--warfare.

G4753.def: from «4754»; an armament, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic):--army, soldier, man of war.

G4754.et: middle voice from the base of (4756)
G4754.def: middle voice from the base of «4756»; to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations:--soldier, (go to) war(-fare).

G4755.et: from the base of (4756) and (71) or (2233)
G4755.def: from the base of «4756» and «71» or «2233»; a general, i.e. (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (praetor), the chief (praefect) of the (Levitical) temple-wardens:--captain, magistrate.

G4756.et: from a derivative of stratos (an army from the base of (4766), as encamped)
G4756.def: feminine of a derivative of stratos (an army; from the base of «4766», as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries:--host.

G4757.et: from a presumed derivative of the same as (4756)
G4757.def: from a presumed derivative of the same as «4756»; a camper-out, i.e. a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively):--soldier.

G4758.et: from a compound of the base of (4756) and (3004) (in its original sense)
G4758.def: from a compound of the base of «4756» and «3004» (in its original sense); to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army:--choose to be a soldier.

G4759.pos:
1. the commander of a camp and army, a military tribune
  2. Praetorian prefect, commander of the praetorian cohorts, captain of the Roman emperor's body guard
G4759.def: from «4760» and «757»; a ruler of an army, i.e. (specially), a Praetorian praefect:--captain of the guard.

G4760.et: from the base of (4756) and the same as (3977)
G4760.def: from the base of «4756» and the same as «3977»; a camping-ground, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops:--army.

G4761.def: from a derivative of «4762»; to wrench, i.e. (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert:-- wrest.

G4762.def: strengthened from the base of «5157»; to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively):--convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about).

G4763.def: from a presumed derivative of «4764»; to be luxurious:--live deliciously.

G4764.def: akin to «4731»; a "straining", "strenuousness" or "strength", i.e. (figuratively) luxury (voluptuousness):--delicacy.

G4765.def: diminutive of strouthos (a sparrow); a little sparrow:--sparrow.

G4766.et: prolongation from a still simpler stroo {stro'-o} (used only as an alternate in certain tenses, probably akin to (4731) through the idea of positing)
G4766.def: (probably akin to «4731» through the idea of positing); to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch):--make bed, furnish, spread, strew.

G4767.et: from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary stugo (to hate)
G4767.def: from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary stugo (to hate); hated, i.e. odious:--hateful.

G4768.def: from the same as «4767»; to render gloomy, i.e. (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech):--lower, be sad.

G4769.et: from stuo (to stiffen, properly akin to the base of (2476))
G4769.def: from stuo (to stiffen; properly akin to the base of «2476»); a post ("style"), i.e. (figuratively) support:--pillar.

G4770.def: from «4745»; a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy:--Stoick.

G4771.et: the person pronoun of the second person singular
G4771.def: the person pronoun of the second person singular; thou:-- thou. See also «4571», «4671», «4675»; and for the plural «5209», «5210», «5213», «5216».

G4773.def: from «4862» and «1085»; a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman:--cousin, kin(-sfolk, -sman).

G4774.def: from a compound of «4862» and «1097»; fellow knowledge, i.e. concession:--permission.

G4775.def: from «4862» and «2521»; to seat oneself in company with:--sit with.

G4776.def: from «4862» and «2523»; to give (or take) a seat in company with:--(make) sit (down) together.

G4777.def: from «4862» and «2553»; to suffer hardship in company with:--be partaker of afflictions.

G4778.def: from «4862» and «2558»; to maltreat in company with, i.e. (passively) endure persecution together:--suffer affliction with.

G4781.def: from «4862» and «2578»; to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict:--bow down.

G4782.def: from «4862» and «2597»; to descend in company with:--go down with.

G4783.def: from «4784»; a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with:--agreement.

G4784.def: mid from «4862» and «2698»; to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to accord with:--consent.

G4785.et: from (4862) and a compound of (2596) and (5585)
G4785.def: from «4862» and a compound of «2596» and «5585»; to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among:--number with.

G4786.def: from «4862» and «2767»; to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate:--mix with, temper together.

G4787.def: from «4682» and «2795»; to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition):--stir up.

G4788.def: from «4862» and «2808»; to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to:--conclude, inclose, shut up.

G4789.def: from «4862» and «2818»; a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common:--fellow (joint)-heir, heir together, heir with.

G4790.def: from «4862» and «2841»; to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in:--communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of.

G4791.def: from «4862» and «2844»; a co-participant:--companion, partake(-r, -r with).

G4792.def: from «4862» and «2865»; to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others:--carry.

G4793.def: from «4862» and «2919»; to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance):--compare among (with).

G4794.def: from «4862» and «2955»; to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by:--bow together.

G4795.et: from a comparative of (4862) and kureo (to light or happen
G4795.def: from a comparative of «4862» and kureo (to light or happen; from the base of «2962»); concurrence, i.e. accident:--chance.

G4796.def: from «4862» and «5463»; to sympathize in gladness, congratulate:--rejoice in (with).

G4797.et: from (4862) and cheo (to pour) or its alternate
G4797.def: from «4862» and cheo (to pour) or its alternate; to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind):--confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar.

G4798.def: from «4862» and «5530»; to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common:--have dealings with.
